gloss: eating oneself into ruin; Osaka's food culture

definitions.gloss: eating oneself into ruin; spending all one's money on food
definitions.explanation: Spending so much on food and dining that one goes broke. Describes a lifestyle of prioritizing eating to an extreme degree.

definitions.gloss: Osaka's reputation as a food capital
definitions.explanation: A cultural nickname for Osaka, famous for the saying {大阪|おおさか}の{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ (Osaka's eat-till-you-drop culture). Refers to the city's reputation for abundant, affordable, and delicious food.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{倒|だお}れの{街|まち}、{大阪|おおさか}へ{行|い}こう。
examples.english: Let's go to Osaka, the city of eat-till-you-drop.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}は{食|く}い{倒|だお}れの{街|まち}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Osaka is known as the food-lovers' city.

examples.japanese: {毎晩|まいばん}{外食|がいしょく}ばかりしていたら、{食|く}い{倒|だお}れになってしまう。
examples.english: If you keep eating out every night, you'll eat yourself into ruin.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}で{大阪|おおさか}に{行|い}き、たこ{焼|や}きやお{好|この}み{焼|や}きなど{食|く}い{倒|だお}れを{満喫|まんきつ}してきた。
examples.english: I went to Osaka on a trip and fully enjoyed the eat-till-you-drop food culture, with takoyaki and okonomiyaki.

examples.japanese: {京|きょう}の{着倒|きだお}れ、{大阪|おおさか}の{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ。
examples.english: Kyoto spends itself on clothing; Osaka on food.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{倒|だお}れの{精神|せいしん}で、{一|ひと}つの{街|まち}で{朝|あさ}から{晩|ばん}まで{食|た}べ{歩|ある}きをした。
examples.english: In the spirit of eat-till-you-drop, I spent from morning to night eating my way through one neighborhood.

notes:
Compound of {食|く}い (eating) + {倒|だお}れ (falling down/going bankrupt). Part of a famous set of sayings about Japanese cities.

FAMOUS SAYING:
{京|きょう}の{着倒|きだお}れ、{大阪|おおさか}の{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ — Kyoto bankrupts you with clothing, Osaka with food. This saying captures the cultural priorities of each city.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|く}い{倒|だお}れの{街|まち} (the food city, i.e., Osaka)
- {食|く}い{倒|だお}れを{満喫|まんきつ}する (fully enjoy the food culture)
- {大阪|おおさか}の{食|く}い{倒|だお}れ (Osaka's eat-till-you-drop reputation)

USAGE:
The famous くいだおれ{太郎|たろう} (Kuidaore Tarō) is a mechanical clown figure on Osaka's Dōtonbori street, one of the city's most recognizable landmarks. While the original restaurant closed in 2008, the figure remains a popular tourist photo spot.
